parity.note: parity is a stored-vs-replayed J comparison; the three unpaired rows are a distinct unsupported/partial case and are never pooled as parity

evidence.support: native-only ATH v4 cohort; 196-200 scored rows are below the spec's 100-unique-observations/five-independent-group screening policy and the archive has no recorded run/experiment identity. Effects and interactions are descriptive model diagnostics, never recommendations.

validation.method: deterministic 5-fold KFold over designs (shuffle, fixed seed)
validation.note: design-level folds, not independent experiments; no run_id is recorded for this cohort

screening_policy.note: 196-200 rows are below the spec's 100-per-group policy and the archive has no recorded independent experiment groups; results are descriptive diagnostics, never recommendations

importance.method: held-out R2 loss under correlated-feature group permutation; 10 repeats; NOT delta-J and NOT causal

effect_curves.note: effect curves are descriptive; model summary uses out-of-fold J predictions; no causal label or automatic pinning

interactions.method: D_ij = f(x+h ei+h ej) - f(x+h ei) - f(x+h ej) + f(x); ExtraTrees finite model changes at normalized steps 0.025/0.05/0.10
interactions.interpretation: local MODEL nonadditivity only; not a derivative, not a causal acoustic interaction, not fANOVA and not a p-value

support_policy.supported_if: all four endpoint nearest-training distances <= 95th percentile AND at least one training design in the 2D +/-h projection
support_policy.boundary_anchors: excluded explicitly per step; never clipped
support_policy.note: nearest-neighbour distance and 2D projected support are diagnostics, not a joint-support certificate

controls_projection.note: B2 active-projection-v1 (morph_exponent held at its reference value)

design_selection.description: seed = lowest frozen-J scored design; remaining slots = maximin normalized Euclidean spread within the better half (J <= median), ties by lower J then design hash; deterministic

recommendation.note: no design is pinned; the report is an explanation artifact

limitations: Source-piston caveat: the task uses a 2-inch uniform piston source with f11 ~= 3957 Hz; 300-8000 Hz results above the caveat are geometry comparisons under that excitation, not a universal validity boundary.
Loading weight is 0.0: no loading, efficiency, distortion or maximum-SPL claims are made.
No independent experiment identity: run_id/experiment_id are absent on every native row; rows are not five independent groups and design-level folds are not experimental replicates.
ExtraTrees is discontinuous: permutation importance is held-out R2 loss, never delta-J; interaction D_ij are finite model changes, not physical derivatives or causal acoustic interactions.
Exact normalized steps 0.025/0.05/0.10 are MODEL diagnostics only; unsupported or boundary-truncated pairs are reported as not_estimable, never clipped.
Geometry descriptors are a canonical sampled-surface approximation through the installed hornlab_mesher API; they are not production cache keys and not a mesh / BEM convergence proof.
The cohort is below the protocol's 100-per-group screening policy and historical search sampling is biased; effect curves and interaction rankings are descriptive.
J is not comparable across objective versions; this report is v4 only and the three replay identities are reported separately.
